status_summary: A presidential memorandum dated 2025-01-24 revoked the 2021 memorandum and reinstated the 2017 Mexico City Policy, directing State to extend it to global health assistance furnished by all agencies. On 2026-01-27 State published a final rule, Protecting Life in Foreign Assistance (2 CFR part 602, effective 2026-02-26), applying award terms to non-military foreign assistance including humanitarian aid: foreign NGOs and international organizations may not provide or promote abortion as family planning or fund others that do, US NGOs must keep funded work separate, foreign governments are covered on narrower terms, terms flow down to subrecipients, and violations can bring termination, refund, suspension or debarment. UNFPA appears on the 2026-01-07 withdrawal list. The Mandate asked for an executive order; the administration used a memorandum followed by a final rule issued without notice and comment under grants and foreign-affairs exemptions.

timeline.event: A presidential memorandum revoked the January 2021 memorandum on protecting women's health at home and abroad and reinstated the 2017 Mexico City Policy, with a plan to extend it to global health assistance from all departments and agencies (published 2025-02-03).
The UN Population Fund was included among the 31 UN entities from which agencies were directed to withdraw (published 2026-01-16).

State published the final rule Protecting Life in Foreign Assistance (91 FR 3319), extending abortion-related award terms beyond global health to non-military foreign assistance, adding US NGO separation requirements, subrecipient flow-down, waivers and enforcement penalties.

GAO reported under the Congressional Review Act that State's Protecting Life in Foreign Assistance rule is a major rule effective 2026-02-26, with State estimating about $114 million in annual training and compliance costs.
The rule took effect for new awards and for existing awards when new funds are added; contracts are not yet covered and the paperwork requirement awaits OMB approval.
